'''Kral'to''' was a location in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The elders of Kral'to told the tale of an ancient traveler who could cure [[Disease/Legends|diseases]].

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] [[FR-D 8T-KA]] mentioned the elders of Kral'to during a conversation with the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] described them as one of the various Outer Rim cultures that had legends of organics being restored.
